game_title: Flowchart Workshop – Odd numbers, sum, and count
game_concept: A drag-and-drop algorithm puzzle in The Kingdom: create the requested executable flowchart.
theme: The Kingdom – Wall Battlements: the high battlements
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read n. Print every positive odd number strictly less than n, then print their sum and count. Start with i = 1.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
win_condition: Build a complete chart whose execution produces the required outputs for every example input.
lose_condition: The run ends after the available unsuccessful chart checks are used.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Wall Battlements'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Drag correctly shaped blocks into the chart and follow the arrows.
Select Check chart to run example inputs. Revise incorrect steps and try again.
